title: Sharp edges can cut your mouth
text:
Sharp edges can cut your mouth. I would never buy these again and was tempted to send them back. I guess you get what you pay for. They are very cheaply made and have sharp plastic ridges at the top of the glasses edges that can cut your lips. Extremely lightweight and even though mine are only a few weeks old, supposedly dishwasher safe on the top rack, they have started to wear from being put in the dishwasher.
Steer clear of these glasses. Spend the extra few bucks and buy the more expensive ones. These aren’t work the savings .
